text.en: The measured scope is the frozen matrix in the cited evidence bundle on one NVIDIA H20 environment; it is not a claim about every Hopper GPU or shape.
text.zh: 测量范围仅限于所引证据包中的冻结矩阵和一套 NVIDIA H20 环境，并不代表所有 Hopper GPU 或所有形状。

text.en: Every latency and ratio is resolved from its evidence class's canonical performance.json; TIRx latency divided by comparator latency is reported, so lower is faster.
text.zh: 所有延迟和比值均从各自证据类别的 canonical performance.json 解析；报告的是 TIRx 延迟除以对照实现延迟，因此数值越低越快。

text.en: The packed-n10 row is not a CuTeDSL speed win; its exact ratio remains inside the preregistered noise band.
text.zh: packed-n10 这一行并非相对 CuTeDSL 的性能胜出；其精确比值仍在预先登记的噪声区间内。

text.en: This bundle is HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_BOUND and is not an independent rerun from the public tags.
text.zh: 该证据包的等级是 HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_BOUND，并非从公开标签独立重跑所得。

text.en: The compiler result is the SM90a capability required by this operator, not complete TVM support for every SM90 workload.
text.zh: 编译器结果仅覆盖该算子所需的 SM90a 能力，并不表示 TVM 已完整支持所有 SM90 工作负载。

text.en: The optimized public dispatch is an exact allowlist; non-allowlisted shapes use the documented pipeline route.
text.zh: 公开优化调度采用精确白名单；非白名单形状走文档定义的 pipeline 路径。

text.en: The timing region is the final public callable under the frozen benchmark contract, not an end-to-end model benchmark.
text.zh: 计时区域是冻结基准契约下的最终公开可调用路径，并非端到端模型基准。

text.en: The historical CuTeDSL GDN receipts are bound to gdn-sm90a-comparator-r1 at commit 88737e9d906cf313995a092624656a89d74dd65e; gdn2-sm90a-comparator-r0 is explicitly excluded.
text.zh: 历史 CuTeDSL GDN 回执绑定到提交 88737e9d906cf313995a092624656a89d74dd65e 上的 gdn-sm90a-comparator-r1；明确排除 gdn2-sm90a-comparator-r0。

text.en: These are unofficial personal-fork artifacts; no upstream project has merged, endorsed, or released this work.
text.zh: 这些是非官方个人 fork 产物；没有任何上游项目合并、背书或发布该工作。

text.en: The tagged operator contract is BF16 with head dimension 128; that source-level contract must not be generalized to other dtypes or dimensions.
text.zh: 标签源码中的算子契约为 BF16、head dimension 128；不得将该源码级契约泛化到其他数据类型或维度。

forbidden_phrases.pattern: TIRx is always faster than CuTe DSL
forbidden_phrases.reason: The packed-n10 row is not a speed win.
The published compiler scope is capability-specific.
The work is an unofficial personal fork.
The evidence covers a bounded operator matrix.
Only the exact public allowlist uses optimized routes.
公开编译器范围是针对特定算子的能力集合。

forbidden_phrases.pattern: Apache TVM 官方 SM90 版本
forbidden_phrases.reason: 该工作是非官方个人 fork。

forbidden_phrases.pattern: 所有 Hopper 工作负载均已生产就绪
forbidden_phrases.reason: 证据仅覆盖有边界的算子矩阵。

forbidden_phrases.pattern: 所有 GDN 形状都已优化
forbidden_phrases.reason: 只有精确白名单使用优化路径。
A reciprocal latency ratio needs an explicit comparator, row set, and derivation.
No upstream pull request or merge exists.

semantic_prohibitions.rule: Do not present a reciprocal speedup as a latency reduction.
Do not promote HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_BOUND to fresh public-tag reproduction.
Do not use rejected, superseded, or excluded evidence as a current comparator.
